title: LanFour

Quake tournament and choosing an opponent for the match with [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Clan 9]], which was supposed to arrive.
The tournament consisted of two parts,
First part took place on February 27 there were four clans: * [[Image:flag_ru.gif]] [[Data Force]] * [[Image:flag_ru.gif]] [[Funeral Birds]] * [[Image:flag_ru.gif]] [[America Must Die]] * [[Image:flag_ru.gif]] [[Red Devils]] Based on the results of the games, the Penza clan [[Funeral Birds]] was eliminated, the other teams had the same number of points. The second part took place on March 14, 1999. [[America Must Die]] won both their matches, [[Data Force]] won against [[Red Devils]]. After which the AMD clan began to officially wait for the arrival of the clan 9.
